constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_match_record_id) REFERENCES match_records(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (match_record_id) REFERENCES match_records(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE

CHECK (kind = 'passkey'::text AND credential_id IS NOT NULL AND public_key IS NOT NULL AND secret_hash IS NULL OR kind = 'browser'::text AND secret_hash IS NOT NULL AND credential_id IS NULL AND public_key IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE
FOREIGN KEY (match_record_id) REFERENCES match_records(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE
CHECK (role <> 'admin'::text OR hashed_password IS NOT NULL)

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER development_diagnosis_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON development_diagnoses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION banfei_immutable_version()
CREATE TRIGGER development_item_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON development_version_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION banfei_immutable_version()
CREATE TRIGGER development_version_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON development_versions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION banfei_immutable_version()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION <schema>.banfei_immutable_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable version data' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END $function$
